sql_model.form_descr: Capture and maintain the complete statutory record of each fixed asset as required under the Companies Act, from acquisition through its active life.

business_logic.description: Recompute total accumulated depreciation (and its supporting total capitalized cost / residual value / opening accumulated depreciation) for Companies Act reporting
business_logic.spec: Recompute this asset's derived financial figures whenever the user changes any of PURCHASE_COST, OTHER_CAPITALIZED_COST, OPENING_WDV, COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS, COMPANIES_ACT_METHOD or CAPITALIZATION_DATE. Steps: (1) total_capitalized_cost = PURCHASE_COST + OTHER_CAPITALIZED_COST; (2) companies_act_residual_value = round(total_capitalized_cost * COMPANIES_ACT_RESIDUAL_VALUE_PCT / 100, 2); (3) depreciable_base = GREATEST(total_capitalized_cost - companies_act_residual_value, 0); (4) opening_accumulated_depreciation is DERIVED (OPENING_ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION is a protected/read-only column with no item_change of its own): when OPENING_WDV is provided, opening_accumulated_depreciation = GREATEST(LEAST(total_capitalized_cost - OPENING_WDV, depreciable_base), 0); when OPENING_WDV is blank/not entered, opening_accumulated_depreciation = 0 (a fresh asset with no prior depreciation history); (5) years_elapsed = fractional years between CAPITALIZATION_DATE and LEAST(CURRENT_DATE, effective_end), floored at 0, where effective_end = the DISPOSAL_DATE of this asset's FAM_ASSET_DISPOSAL row when one exists with STATUS = 'APPROVED' for this ASSET_CODE, else CURRENT_DATE; (6) if COMPANIES_ACT_METHOD = 'SLM': system_dep = depreciable_base * min(years_elapsed, COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS) / COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS; if COMPANIES_ACT_METHOD = 'WDV': r = 1 - (companies_act_residual_value / total_capitalized_cost) ** (1 / COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS) -- guard divide-by-zero / a zero residual value by capping r at a safe maximum (e.g. 0.999) so the asset's implied closing value never goes below companies_act_residual_value; system_dep = total_capitalized_cost - total_capitalized_cost * (1 - r) ** years_elapsed; (7) total_accumulated_depreciation = GREATEST(opening_accumulated_depreciation, LEAST(opening_accumulated_depreciation + system_dep, depreciable_base)) -- i.e. cap the sum at depreciable_base (total_capitalized_cost - companies_act_residual_value) but never let it fall below the derived opening_accumulated_depreciation itself. Guard: if COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS is missing/zero or CAPITALIZATION_DATE is missing (asset still Draft), return total_accumulated_depreciation = opening_accumulated_depreciation while still returning total_capitalized_cost, companies_act_residual_value and opening_accumulated_depreciation computed normally. Return {"updates": {"total_capitalized_cost": <computed>, "companies_act_residual_value": <computed>, "opening_accumulated_depreciation": <computed>, "total_accumulated_depreciation": <computed>}}. OPENING_ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION is protected/read-only on the transaction model, so this function's return is the only way it gets written. This exact function is invoked from every one of PURCHASE_COST, OTHER_CAPITALIZED_COST, OPENING_WDV, COMPANIES_ACT_USEFUL_LIFE_YEARS, COMPANIES_ACT_METHOD and CAPITALIZATION_DATE (each column's item_change) so the figures update live while the user edits any of them; Transaction objects have no separate on-open/before-load recompute hook, so a record reopened untouched still shows the value as of its last save, not necessarily as of today's calendar date.

column.name: other_capitalized_cost
column.heading: Other Capitalized Cost
column.descr: Freight, installation, duties and other costs capitalized with the asset

column.name: companies_act_residual_value
column.heading: Residual Value

column.name: opening_wdv
column.heading: Opening WDV
column.descr: Written-down value of this asset under the Companies Act as on the date in Opening WDV As On Date, for a pre-existing/legacy asset being onboarded into this depreciation regime. Leave blank for a fresh asset with no prior Companies Act depreciation history. Opening Accumulated Depreciation below is derived automatically from this value.

column.name: opening_accumulated_depreciation
column.heading: Opening Accumulated Depreciation
column.descr: Accumulated depreciation as on the Opening WDV As On Date, computed automatically as Total Capitalized Cost minus Opening WDV. Read-only.

column.name: opening_wdv_as_on_date
column.heading: Opening WDV As On Date
column.descr: Date as of which Opening Accumulated Depreciation is stated for a legacy asset that existed before this system went live (typically a financial-year-end, e.g. 31-Mar). The Companies Act monthly depreciation process uses this date + Opening Accumulated Depreciation as the asset's starting WDV baseline for the first month it processes after this date; leave blank for assets that were capitalized and depreciated for the first time within this system.

column.name: total_accumulated_depreciation
column.heading: Total Accumulated Depreciation
column.descr: System-computed total accumulated depreciation for Companies Act reporting = Opening Accumulated Depreciation + depreciation accumulated by the system's Companies Act SLM/WDV formula from Capitalization Date up to today (or up to disposal, capped so the asset never depreciates below its Companies Act Residual Value).

column.name: income_tax_block_code
column.heading: Income Tax Block Code
column.descr: Income Tax block-of-assets code; defaulted from the asset's category and editable

column.name: income_tax_block_descr
column.heading: Block Description
column.descr: Description of the selected Income Tax block
column.table_display_name: Income Tax depreciation block master (lookup for block description)

column.name: income_tax_opening_wdv
column.heading: Income Tax Opening WDV
column.descr: Written-down value of this asset under the Income Tax Act as on the date in Income Tax Opening WDV As On Date, for a pre-existing/legacy asset being onboarded into Income Tax block depreciation. Leave blank for a fresh asset with no prior Income Tax depreciation history. This is independent of the Companies Act Opening WDV above — the two regimes compute depreciation separately.

column.name: income_tax_opening_wdv_as_on_date
column.heading: Income Tax Opening WDV As On Date
column.descr: Date (typically a financial-year-end, e.g. 31-Mar) as of which Income Tax Opening WDV is stated for a legacy asset that existed before this system went live. Leave blank for assets first capitalized within this system.

column.name: warranty_start_date
column.heading: Warranty Start Date
column.descr: Start date of the manufacturer/vendor warranty

column.name: warranty_end_date
column.heading: Warranty End Date

validations.name: Draft only
validations.message: Only Draft assets can be deleted (current status {form.status}).

business_logic.description: Submit a draft asset for approval
business_logic.spec: Confirm that ASSET_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, BRANCH_CODE, LOCATION_CODE, PURCHASE_DATE, PURCHASE_COST and CAPITALIZATION_DATE are all populated; if any is missing return {"error": "..."} naming the missing field(s). Otherwise set STATUS to 'PENDING_APPROVAL' and return {"updates": {"status": "PENDING_APPROVAL"}}.

validations.name: Must be Draft
validations.message: Only Draft assets can be submitted for approval (current status {form.status}).

business_logic.spec: Set STATUS to 'CAPITALIZED' and lock the core financial fields (PURCHASE_COST, CAPITALIZATION_DATE, CATEGORY_CODE, OPENING_ACCUMULATED_DEPRECIATION) so they cannot be changed once capitalized, by returning them as protected cells. Return {"updates": {"status": "CAPITALIZED", "purchase_cost": {"protect": "1"}, "capitalization_date": {"protect": "1"}, "category_code": {"protect": "1"}, "opening_accumulated_depreciation": {"protect": "1"}}}. Once approved the asset becomes eligible for depreciation processing and visible in Locations & Assignment, Depreciation, Lifecycle and Verification activities.

validations.name: Must be Pending Approval
validations.message: Only assets Pending Approval can be approved (current status {form.status}).

business_logic.description: Reject a submitted asset back to Draft
business_logic.spec: Set STATUS back to 'DRAFT' so the asset details can be corrected and resubmitted, and return {"updates": {"status": "DRAFT"}}.

validations.name: Must be Pending Approval
validations.message: Only assets Pending Approval can be rejected (current status {form.status}).

business_logic.description: Generate a QR code / barcode tag for the asset
business_logic.spec: Generate a scannable QR/barcode payload (e.g. a short encoded string or URL embedding ASSET_CODE) that uniquely identifies this asset, and return {"updates": {"qr_barcode_tag": {"value": <generated tag>, "protect": "1"}}} so the generated tag becomes read-only on the form.

validations.name: Asset must be saved
validations.message: Save the asset before generating its QR/Barcode tag.
